Study notes & sources
Oversized equipment distinguishes roles at map scale. Faction crests supplement color. Joint pivots separate walking, breathing and banner follow-through. Formations show group identity without crowding individual silhouettes.

Original procedural models; animation study only. No combat, pathfinding or imported Asset Factory rigs.

Reference: Christopher Totten — 12 principles for game animation. Applied ideas: readable staging, responsive timing and secondary motion.
